prompt: A brutally simple 2D monochrome physics exam diagram showing two identical beakers side by side on a single horizontal line representing a surface. Both beakers are partially filled with liquid to the same level. Place the label 'X' directly below the left beaker, and the label 'Y' directly below the right beaker. Do not draw leader lines. Use a Times New Roman-like serif font for the labels. The drawing must be a flat, 2D schematic style with crisp black vector-like lines on a pure white #FFFFFF background. Do not draw heaters, thermometers, or any other apparatus. No extra text, no shading, and no 3D perspective.
negative_prompt: Pure white background only; no grey paper, gradient, or texture. No extra labels. No overlap. No sans-serif fonts. No decorative shading. No photorealism. No colour unless explicitly requested. No exact answer-bearing measurements. No clutter. No malformed symbols. Do not place objects in the wrong support/location relationship. No medium label pointing at objects inside the medium. No fluid label terminating on a sphere, wall, or meniscus. No unrequested arrows, force labels, field symbols, construction arcs, or explanatory overlays. No heaters or thermometers.

label_anchors.text_placement: centered directly below the left beaker
centered directly below the right beaker

must_show_relations: both beakers must rest on the same horizontal line
beakers must appear identical in size and shape
relative_size_constraints: left beaker and right beaker are the same size

hard_constraints: background must be pure white #FFFFFF with no grey fill or gradient
no leader lines for the labels
no apparatus other than the two beakers and the surface line
labels must be placed outside and below the beakers
